name: WIT-221 test fixes project context
description: Context for fix/WIT-221-remaining-test-fixes branch — all tests in scope passing, PR #140 open
type: project
---

Working on `fix/WIT-221-remaining-test-fixes` branch — all in-scope tests passing.

**Why:** Test suite was broken by previous changes, blocking staging builds.

**How to apply:** Run tests per package to verify. PR wityliti/witylogix#140 is open against staging.

### packages/core
- 870 tests across 22 modified test files: all passing
- Pre-existing failure in `analytics/__tests__/aggregator.test.ts` (float precision: -33.333... vs -33.3333...336) is NOT in scope for WIT-221

### packages/db
- 147 tests across 4 test files: all passing

### apps/api
- 3401 tests across 74 test files: all passing

| Commit | Change |
|--------|--------|
| `2bf50ea` | Remove orphan cod route import + duplicate validator |
| `1ef0787` | Fix UUID validation + queue mock in collections/shipments/support-tickets |
| `213e846` | Fix remaining test anti-patterns across 23 API test files |
| `b4af215` | Fix timestamp race condition and improve mock patterns in 4 test files |
| `b00abf2` | Add Prisma.Decimal mock to unblock db import in products test |
| `3143e6a` | Fix remaining failures in packages/core and pack

1. `vi.hoisted()` + `vi.mock()` for intercepting already-imported modules (integrations, slack-client)
2. `.mock.results[0].value` accessed before mock is called → move after call
3. UUID validation: pass valid UUIDs in test payloads
4. `createdAt`/`updatedAt` missing from mock returns
5. `Prisma.Decimal` mock to unblock db import
6. Billable weight test: assertion was reversed — bulky light package (99.45lb dim) > heavy small package (50lb)
7. Status transitions: `OUT_FOR_DELIVERY` → `ARRIVED`
